detail.notes: Device fanout confirms the exact mobile profile was used across numerous distinct cards in rapid succession, all via anonymous proxy and flagged as new devices. Card history for C13487 shows a prior online purchase from the same profile 7 days earlier with matching billing attributes. The pattern strongly mirrors the shared-device fraud ring documented in prior cases (CC-2985, CC-2649). Remaining uncertainty lies in distinguishing whether this specific cardholder is a willing participant or an account-takeover victim.
